manual.label: Display mode
manual.why: Exclusive fullscreen has the lowest input latency.

manual.label: Multithreaded rendering
manual.why: Lets Valorant spread its work across your CPU cores.

manual.label: Material quality
manual.why: Surface detail you don't need to spot anyone.

manual.label: Texture quality
manual.why: Frees video memory. Sharper walls show you nothing new.

manual.label: Vignette
manual.why: Darkens the edges of your screen.

manual.label: V-Sync
manual.why: V-Sync holds frames back, which adds input lag.

manual.label: Bloom
manual.why: Glow can hide enemies near bright lights.

manual.label: NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency
manual.why: Cuts the delay between your click and the shot on NVIDIA cards.
